# Real archived PRE fragmentation regression

The frozen `teem` input is the source-confirmed 2027 card with two original AS history slots. All gzip members expand to the exact independently pinned delivery/profile/parts listed in `manifest.json`; the decoder is a byte slice of the pinned prepared module. No original text, attributes or history count was shortened.

Safari reported a PRE graph child census of expected one / actual two with otherwise equal tag, namespace and attributes. The test simulates a browser splitting a long Text node with `splitText`, and requires exact concatenated text, original attributes, original owner and unchanged AS capabilities. Other node types, changed text, changed attributes and non-PRE fragmentation must remain rejected. This fixture is a bounded DOM regression, not native Anki, full author-loader or browser performance acceptance.
